layers.name: admin
layers.select: osm_id, admin_level AS fclass, name

layers.name: buildings
layers.select: osm_id, building AS fclass, name, type

layers.name: landuse
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(landuse, "natural", leisure) AS fclass, name
layers.where: landuse IS NOT NULL OR "natural" IN ('wood','forest','scrub','heath','meadow') OR leisure = 'park'

layers.name: natural_a
layers.select: osm_id, "natural" AS fclass, name

layers.name: natural
layers.select: osm_id, "natural" AS fclass, name

layers.name: places_a
layers.select: osm_id, place AS fclass, population, name

layers.name: places
layers.select: osm_id, place AS fclass, population, name

layers.name: pofw_a
layers.select: osm_id, amenity AS fclass, name

layers.name: pofw
layers.select: osm_id, amenity AS fclass, name

layers.name: pois_a
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(amenity, shop, tourism, leisure, historic, man_made) AS fclass, name
layers.where: amenity IS NOT NULL OR shop IS NOT NULL OR tourism IS NOT NULL OR leisure IS NOT NULL OR historic IS NOT NULL OR man_made IS NOT NULL

layers.name: pois
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(amenity, shop, tourism, leisure, historic, man_made) AS fclass, name
layers.where: amenity IS NOT NULL OR shop IS NOT NULL OR tourism IS NOT NULL OR leisure IS NOT NULL OR historic IS NOT NULL OR man_made IS NOT NULL

layers.name: protected
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(boundary, leisure) AS fclass, name

layers.name: railways
layers.select: osm_id, railway AS fclass, name, layer, bridge, tunnel

layers.name: roads
layers.select: osm_id, highway AS fclass, name, ref, oneway, maxspeed, layer, bridge, tunnel

layers.name: traffic_a
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(amenity, highway) AS fclass, name, calming

layers.name: traffic
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(highway, railway, amenity, waterway, man_made) AS fclass, name, calming
layers.where: highway IN ('traffic_signals','crossing','stop','mini_roundabout','turning_circle','motorway_junction','speed_camera','street_lamp') OR railway IN ('crossing','level_crossing') OR amenity IN ('fuel','parking','bicycle_parking','bicycle_repair_station','marina') OR waterway IN ('dam','weir','waterfall','lock_gate','slipway') OR man_made = 'pier'

layers.name: transport_a
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(aeroway, amenity, railway, highway) AS fclass, name
layers.where: aeroway IS NOT NULL OR amenity IN ('bus_station','ferry_terminal','taxi') OR railway IN ('station','halt') OR highway = 'platform'

layers.name: transport
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE(aeroway, railway, highway, amenity) AS fclass, name
layers.where: aeroway IS NOT NULL OR railway IN ('station','halt','tram_stop','subway_entrance','platform','stop_position') OR highway IN ('bus_stop','platform') OR amenity IN ('bus_station','ferry_terminal','taxi') OR public_transport = 'platform'

layers.name: water
layers.select: osm_id, COALESCE("natural", landuse, waterway) AS fclass, name
layers.where: "natural" IN ('water','wetland','glacier') OR landuse = 'reservoir' OR waterway IN ('riverbank','dock')

layers.name: waterways
layers.select: osm_id, waterway AS fclass, width, name
